name: Mutant Cryptid Pine Pangolin
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-11: The Hidden Current

offensiveAbilities.name: Explosive End
offensiveAbilities.description: The mutant pangolin's death reveals one last surprise as it explodes into splinters. When it dies, it explodes, dealing 4d6 Piercing Damage damage to each creature in a 10ft Emanation, with a basic Basic DC 26 Reflex Saving Throw save.

offensiveAbilities.name: Roll Up
offensiveAbilities.description: The mutant pine pangolin falls Prone, closes up its scales, and rolls into a ball. While Rolled Up, the pangolin gains resistance 10 to physical damage and total immunity to falling damage from heights of 50 feet or less. The only action the pine pangolin can take is to Stand, and the effects of Roll Up end once the pangolin Stands.

offensiveAbilities.name: Secrete Tar
offensiveAbilities.description: The mutant pine pangolin secretes a brown, sticky tar within a 5ft Emanation, making those squares difficult terrain for 1 minute. Each creature that enters or starts its turn in a tarred square must succeed at a DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Immobilized until it Escapes. On a critical failure, the creature falls Prone; prone creatures take a –2 circumstance penalty to their checks to Escape the tar. The pine pangolin is immune to the effects of its own tar.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shifting Iridescence
offensiveAbilities.description: Whenever the mutant pine pangolin takes energy damage to which it isn't resistant or immune, after taking the damage normally, it gains resistance 5 to that damage type. If it had a resistance to a different damage type from shifting iridescence, it replaces the old resistance with the new resistance.

offensiveAbilities.name: Unusual Bane
offensiveAbilities.description: This mutant pine pangolin is traumatized by the former Conference Z staff who teamed up to hold it down while experimenting on it. The first time each round the mutant pine pangolin comes within 15 feet of any character who took the Aid action, or is attacked while being flanked by two characters, it takes 8 Mental Damage damage and must attempt a DC 26 Will Saving Throw save. On a failure, it is Stunned 1 (Stunned 3 on a critical failure).

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

recallKnowledge: Arcana or Nature or Nature, DC 24
